import sys,time,csv,io,base64,resource,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
from common import validate,COLUMNS
from gen_targets import plan
from classify_responses import capture_records
from census import build
random.seed(1)
job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':[{'id':'h','prefix':'2001:db8::/56','start':0,'end':10**12,'subnets':[0],'low_count':32}],'services':[{'id':f's{i}','kind':'tcp'} for i in range(8)],'queries':[10,20,30,40],'captures':[],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
ctx=validate(job);manifest,lookup,low=plan(ctx['leases'],ctx['seed'])
s=io.StringIO(newline='');w=csv.writer(s,lineterminator='\n');w.writerow(COLUMNS)
for i in range(1,33):
 w.writerow(['icmp',f'ic{i}','0','1','put','h',str(i),f'0/i{i}',f'2001:db8::{i}',f'2001:db8::{i}','echo','','',''])
for j in range(200000-32):
 w.writerow(['app',f'a{j}','0','1','put','h','1','',f'2001:db8::{(j%32)+1}','','closed',f's{j%8}','0',''])
data=s.getvalue().encode();print('csv bytes',len(data))
ctx2=dict(ctx);ctx2['captures']=[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(data).decode()]}]
t=time.time();recs,rej=capture_records(ctx2,lookup);print('capture',time.time()-t,len(recs),len(rej))
t=time.time();snaps,active=build(ctx,recs,low);print('census',time.time()-t,'snaps',len(snaps))
print('unbound',[x['unbound_applications'] for x in snaps])
print('maxrss',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
EOF
